description: GET /agents/{id}/pnl (§4.7, DEC-2413): the agent sub-ledger's gross realized and unrealized P&L (trading spec §8.1, §8.2), folded from the account stream of the connection the deployed document names, as GET /agents/{id}/positions folds it. No net realized or total P&L: the journal attributes fees and income to no agent. as_of names the control stream and the account stream read.

realized_gross.description: The sum of the instruments' realized_gross; null when any one is.

unrealized_pnl.description: The sum of the instruments' unrealized_pnl; null when any one is.

Instrument.description: One instrument the agent's own fills touched, a closed position included, in instrument order.

filled_qty.description: The net quantity of the agent's own fills; 0 for a closed position.

realized_gross.description: Trading spec §8.1's realized column summed over the agent's fills, fees not taken off; null where the positions read's cost_basis is.

unrealized_pnl.description: §8.2's at the positions read's risk mark, as that read serves it, or 0 for a flat position; null where the basis or a sane mark is not served.
